notes:
- Each account type gets its own receivable and payable sub-account in the chart of accounts (for example customers, students, suppliers and personnel), so the trial balance shows balances by account type; new account types get their accounts automatically
- Payment types show the ledger account they post to in every bookkeeping mode
- POS payment types can have the number of days until the money reaches the bank; credit cards can have a statement day and a payment due day. Collections and payments then show the day the money actually moves, and the cash flow report uses that date
- Cheque and note payments require a maturity date; they appear in the cash flow on that date and in a new "Cheques / notes" view under Due tracking
- Opening cash balances in a foreign currency or metal require an exchange rate
- After a day is closed, the payment type of its entries can no longer be changed
- In opening balances the transaction category comes right after the account
- The account list shows all accounts in card view by default
- An account with a balance cannot be made inactive
- Entry forms: field descriptions open from the (i) next to the field name, and the note field fills the free space in its row
- LedgerPro cleans up its own temporary and cache files at startup and exit; your data and backups are never touched
- A smaller download
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
